The Arabs’ inability to produce its like — though they were the most eloquent of people — shows that the Qur’an is revelation from Allah. Opinions on interpreting these letters are many and varied. They comprise fourteen letters of the Arabic alphabet and form the phrase: “A wise text with a decisive secret”; a group of interpreters said they are Allah’s secret in the Qur’an.
